english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not normal, including unusual behavior or a mental state.
Use this all-purpose choice when something does not conform to what is considered normal, especially with a mildly negative implication.
This is the all-purpose casual choice for behaviour that deviates from expectations or social norms.
Use this when something is functioning or behaving abnormally rather than simply being broken.
Use this when a bodily or mental function is not operating normally, rather than when something is merely untidy.
